text:
Avery: Heads up—I'm in Copenhagen next week, office around Islands Brygge. Looking for: casual group dinner (8 ppl, no reservation), great late-night kebab/shawarma, and a bakery for morning pastries. Any local faves?

Nikhil: Islands Brygge has a bunch of good spots. For casual group dinner try Bror on the waterfront, they usually seat walk-ins and have big plates to share.

Sara: For kebab, Mustafa's Kebab (near Nørrebro) is iconic but a trek. Closer, there9s Kebabi in Vesterbro that's open late and solid.

Ben: Bakery: Lagkagehuset is everywhere and reliable for morning pastries. If you want something smaller/more local, Andersen & Maillard in Christianshavn is lovely.

Tove: If you want a mid-range restaurant that can do 8 without a planned reservation, try Mother (Italian, big pizzas). They usually are chill about groups if you come early.

Avery: Thanks! Any spots that do vegetarian-friendly smørrebrød or plates? Someone on the team is vegetarian.

Sara: Try Den Lille Fede in the meatpacking for veggie-forward options. Also Hija de Sanchez does a veg taco that9s surprisingly good.

Nikhil: SnackBot suggests nearby picks (Islands Brygge radius): 1) Bror (shared plates) 2) Lagkagehuset (bakery) 3) Kebab i Kbh (late-night) — source: internal snack index https://snack.internal/cph-list :robot_face:

Ben: FYI, public transport from airport to Islands Brygge is easy via M2 metro to Christianshavn, then a 10-min walk. Helpful for anyone flying in.

Avery: Great. I'm leaning Bror for Thursday night, then kebab after if folks want. Who's up for 8pm Thu walk-in? React with :thumbsup: to join.

Tove: :thumbsup: I can make it.

Nikhil: :thumbsup: In.

Sara: Maybe later, but high chance :thumbsup:.

Ben: :thumbsup: sounds good. I can handle checking if they can accommodate 8 without booking.

Avery: Amazing—Ben, if you want, ping me after you check. Also any dessert recs nearby for post-dinner?

Tove: Head to Conditori La Glace if you're willing to go towards the city center, their cakes are legendary. Otherwise Torvehallerne has some stalls with sweets.

Ben: Just called Bror, they said walk-ins are fine but recommended arriving ~7:45 for a group of 8. I'll post a quick message when I'm there to hold the spot if others are running late.

Avery: Perfect, appreciate it! I'll DM travel details to the group and add a quick calendar invite for Thu 8pm by the Bror entrance. See you in CPH :airplane:
